evidence.detail: Open feature request: surface 'this is your best deck' to players using Wilson interval lower bound
wilson_lower_bound_sql() exists and is used for archetype/deck ordering, but there is no per-player best-deck computation or display anywhere
No 'best deck' feature found in current master

triage.notes: Requires: per-player Wilson lower bound computed across all their decks, a decision on where to display it (player profile? notification?), and new template/view code. Related to #12397 in that both leverage Wilson lower bound but serve different audiences.
